def: to enjoin (by writing), i.e. (genitive case) to communicate by letter (for any purpose)

occurrences.text: But that we write unto them, that they abstain from pollutions of idols, and from fornication, and from things strangled, and from blood.

As touching the Gentiles which believe, we have written and concluded that they observe no such thing, save only that they keep themselves from things offered to idols, and from blood, and from strangled, and from fornication.
And I beseech you, brethren, suffer the word of exhortation: for I have written a letter unto you in few words.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
